info.title: RenOS API
info.description: RenOS management platform API for device fleet management, automation, monitoring, and infrastructure orchestration.

get.description: Returns the dashboard, its widgets, and hydrated display data for each config-driven widget type, keyed by widget ID in widget_data.

put.description: Updates dashboard metadata and, when widgets are provided, atomically replaces the full widget set (used by the dashboard builder).

get.description: Lists the current user's in-app notifications with optional filters: unread, type, search, limit, offset.

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: Only return unread notifications when true.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by notification type (alert, workflow, job, ai, system, mention).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across title and body.

get.summary: Global search across devices, jobs, workflows, plugins, policies, secrets, users, logs, containers, VMs and cluster nodes

type.description: alert, workflow, job, ai, system or mention

widget_type.description: chart, devices-overview, device-status, cpu, memory, alerts, logs, workflows, ai-usage, containers or proxmox

bearerAuth.description: JWT Bearer token for user authentication
